uncited: If the step size ($dt$) is too large relative to the feature size of the density field, it produces aliased noise.
*   **Performance Overhead:** A new marching loop in the hot path adds compile-time and runtime overhead to all scenes.
*   **RHI Limitations:** The engine's RHI lacks 3D texture support (no depth field in `TextureDesc`, no samplers, bilinear interpolation is hand-written).
Using 3D textures requires ~400 LOC of new RHI code and unproven `RWTexture3D` lowering on Slang targets.
